summary: Northern Crane tower near Waggoner Cemetery in Martin County, Indiana; partly demolished, with only the bottom part left as of 2025 per Indiana Fire Towers; NHLR-registered August 2026.

facts.status_note: Partly demolished: the cab is no longer in place, and Indiana Fire Towers says only the bottom part remained as of 2025. FFLA lists it as standing with an asterisk.

access.note: Restricted federal Naval property; Indiana Fire Towers reports no public access

visit.trail_note: Indiana Fire Towers says it is not possible to visit or climb the tower

events.note: A September 1939 Outdoor Indiana map shows a tower near the lake at Crane; Indiana Fire Towers counts it among the Crane-area towers but does not confirm it is this tower
Half-demolished in the February 2025 photo; Indiana Fire Towers says only the bottom part remains

corrections.current: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone (FFLA).
corrections.proposed: Partly demolished: the cab is no longer in place, and Indiana Fire Towers says only the bottom part remained as of 2025.
corrections.why: FFLA's asterisk covers towers whose cab is gone, but Indiana Fire Towers describes only the bottom part remaining, which is a bigger loss than 'still stands' suggests.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA says the structure and support remain with the cab gone; Indiana Fire Towers says only the bottom part remains. Both are reported in the story, which says the two do not fully agree.

notes_for_editor: The name is spelled Waggoner by FFLA and Indiana Fire Towers, and Waggoneer by the NHLR; the story uses Waggoner where it quotes or names the cemetery. No build year is found for this tower. The 1939 tower near the lake is linked to this site only by inference, and the story says so. The Forest Service numbered list does not map cleanly to this tower. The 2025 condition is consistent between the NHLR photo caption and the Indiana Fire Towers text. Not verified: any further demolition after February 2025. The story also reports the 2004 satellite image on the same Indiana Fire Towers page, which appears to show the whole tower, beside the 2025 photo that shows the cab missing.
